newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales rise 2.8 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales rise 2.8 pct in May.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, rose 2.8 percent in May from the same month last year after a year-on-year rise of 2.0 percent in April and a decline of 1.5 percent in May last year, the Federal Statistics Office said.

Adjusted for inflation, the office said real retail turnover in May was 2.2 percent higher than in May last year, with sales of foods up 2.0 percent and clothes and textiles up 2.6 percent. Sales in all other sectors were up by 2.4 percent.
For the first five months of 1997, the value of retail sales was unchanged as compared to the same period a year ago.
The office said real sales were down 0.5 percent in the first five months of 1997 as compared to the same 1996 period.
